dedupe_keys.name: remind r package for remind scenario output

description: remind is an R package from the PIK integrated-assessment modelling group for manipulating REMIND model data and outputs. It contains REMIND-specific routines and a vignette for summaries and visualisation, making scenario results easier to inspect and compare. Users provide compatible REMIND run output and choose variables, regions or scenario years; outputs are processed tables and plots for the selected experiment. Geographic coverage follows the parent REMIND run. The package DESCRIPTION states free LGPL-3.0 terms, and the README gives installation from PIK's R repository. The GitHub source had not received a code push since 2021 in the reviewed metadata, so compatibility with a newer REMIND release should be checked. A limitation is that a post-processing tool cannot validate the energy-system equations or source data. It can help interpret electricity and fuel pathways used in infrastructure planning. The related catalogue OSeMOSYS model is a separate optimiser. No run results or R package were downloaded.
